questionSnapshot.question: What year was the Disney film Fantasia originally released?

notes: Four plausible classic-era years. Hard date recall retained. Independently corroborated by AFI and Disney. #169 Oscar timing and #400 Burbank move merely share a year; #939 requires the separate Fantasound/film association.

verification.context: Fantasia, original US world-premiere release in 1940, not Fantasia 2000 or later reissues.

sources.locator: Film entry: premiere at Broadway Theater, New York, November 13, 1940; reissue years listed separately.
AFI catalog heading Fantasia (1940), 13 November 1940; History documents development beginning in 1937, distinct from release.

options.reason: 1937 is when development began, not its release year.
